extracted.name: Malteser tray bake
extracted.description: This recipe was submitted by Good Food member garyirving and has not been tested by our team.
ingredient_lines: Extra 100g milk or white chocolate as topping
instruction_lines: Melt the butter, chocolate and syrup.
Add the crushed biscuits and Maltesers.
Mix together then pour into a greased baking tin and chill until set.
Optional: Once set, melt the additional chocolate and pour over the top. Chill until set.
